history: Unchanged v2 strict 500000us / <=10 historical sweeps; all new comparisons use strict baseline; v1 results retained as historical only
models: No new inference, weights unchanged; reuse frozen predictions and candidate geometry
seg_strict_rebase: Same frozen semantic-cluster geometry. Reassociate to strict detector using unchanged2m same-class gate; reset proposal score to0.5*cluster confidence and zero velocity/default attribute before inheriting matched strict detector score/velocity/attribute. Exact reconstruction against v1 checked on all unchanged frames.
oracle: Unchanged fixed-order greedy lexicographic(sumTP-FP at0.5/1/2/4m, negative matched xy distance); one replacement per original index; no-op ties. Attribute projections keep center/class/score so decisions reused only after invariant checks. Add-only and replacement-only independently reselected.
candidate_gt_separation: GT-free pool generation before private GT loading; serialized pool+projection table and script hashes define all variants; no GT box fitting or candidate parameter tuning
paired_error_analysis: Anchor accepted replacement to baseline same-class score-greedy2m GT match; compare both boxes against that same GT, even if post box crosses2m. Report stable-pair, lost-pair, gained-pair, changed-GT cohorts separately. Use official raw finite velocities, never privateGT nan-to-zero for velocity diagnostics. Simple per-box statistics are not official recall-weighted TP errors.
operation_stats: Count variants by append/replace and accepted events; physical yaw differences modulo2pi; numeric fields tolerance1e-6; new box fields are initialization, not overwritten detector attributes; no GT confidence target
tp_fp_analysis: Actual unthresholded submitted boxes after unchanged official range/bike-rack filtering at0.5/1/2/4m; report full and independent append-only/replace-only interventions. Global official AP separately evaluated; no additive AP attribution claim.
evaluator: Unmodified installed nuScenes detection_cvpr_2019 evaluator; sparse overlays reconstructed before official filtering; full Tracking result must reproduce frozen v2 metrics
